item.title: Heard in the Reef, from Ostemenes Nikmenides ~1693: "They say the field at the Burning Lak
item.description: Heard in the Reef, from Ostemenes Nikmenides ~1693: "They say the field at the Burning Lake of Eridanus ran with marrow. Some already call the dead a martyr. They say the Dodonaioi were behind it."
